'''Neb Creip''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] who served in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="DaG" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="ROTS date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> just after the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Creip was one of the thousands of mourners to attend the [[Padmé Amidala's funeral/Legends|funeral]] of Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], walking amongst other senators in the procession behind Amidala's coffin. At the [[Funeral/Legends|funeral]],<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> Creip wore [[Color/Legends|brown]], black, and [[Bronze/Legends|bronze]] floor-length [[Robe/Legends|robes]] with a black [[Hat/Legends|hat]]. The senator had black [[Hair/Legends|hair]], brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and dark skin.<ref name="DaG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Neb Creip first appeared in the final film of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]], [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']],<ref name="ROTS" /> which was released on [[May 19]], [[2005]].<ref name="YearByYear">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> The funeral scene featuring the character was filmed at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[September 16]], [[2003]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> Creip was first identified by name in the reference book ''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]'', written by [[Trisha Biggar]]<ref name="DaG" /> and released on [[October 11]], 2005.<ref name="DressingDate">{{WebCite|url=https://www.waterstones.com/book/dressing-a-galaxy-part-1/trisha-biggar/george-lucas/9780810959644|text=Dressing a Galaxy: Part 1: The Costumes of Star Wars (Hardback)|work=[[Wikipedia:Waterstones|Waterstones]]|archivedate=20260701041521}}</ref>
